subject: general
question: Five people, A, B, C, D and E are sitting in a row, facing north. D sits third from the left end of the line. E sits fifth from the left end of the line. B sits between A and D. Who sits at the extreme left end of the line?6098
solution:
Given: Five people, A, B, C, D and E are sitting in a row, facing north.

1) D sits third from the left end of the line.

2) E sits fifth from the left end of the line.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a613a074490584e091bb479e53f2fc1ca99d852e0738727868a550d6f4144be.png] 

3) B sits between A and D.

The remaining position will be occupied by the only person left i.e. C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eb26ca37aa28d1b57ad90fc925edadfdd63f0ae898e9ebe41be3fdbdc40c7121.png] 

Thus, A sits at the extreme left end of the line.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
